title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has released a response to a 2020 report on Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards, outlining its plans to regulate and develop AI in the UK. This response details the government's policies and standards for the safe and beneficial use of AI in public life.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: This document outlines Ofqual's approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in qualifications. It aims to address concerns from government ministers about how AI is used in the qualifications sector.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document assesses the impact of using copyrighted material in the development of artificial intelligence, evaluating its effects and consequences. It likely explores how copyright law applies to AI systems and suggests potential changes to balance innovation with creators' rights.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to the House of Lords Select Committee's report on Artificial Intelligence, acknowledging its importance in the country's growth. The response outlines the government's plan to address the report's recommendations and ensure AI is used safely and effectively in the UK.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference for a review on how artificial intelligence aligns with public standards, including guidelines and principles that govern its development and use. The review aims to investigate and address any gaps or issues between AI and public standards.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Cabinet Office's Centre for Strategic Partnerships and Delivery (CSPL) has shared its views on the governance of artificial intelligence (AI) with the Science and Technology Committee. The submission is part of the committee's inquiry into AI governance.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy aims to assess the impact of AI on the regulation of medical products by exploring its principles, as outlined in the Artificial Intelligence White Paper. The goal is to ensure medical products are regulated effectively and safely in an era where AI technologies play a significant role.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the defence organisation the most effective, efficient, and influential in its field, leveraging AI advancements. The strategy seeks to accomplish this through the successful application of artificial intelligence.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This policy document outlines the UK government's plan to harness the benefits of artificial intelligence in the transport sector while minimizing its potential risks. The plan is designed to help the Department for Transport work with the transport industry to achieve this goal.

title: Copyright and artificial intelligence: progress report
description: A progress report on the use of copyright works in the development of AI systems, under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
summary: This report discusses the use of copyrighted materials in creating artificial intelligence systems, following the guidelines set out by the Data (Use and Access) Act. It provides an update on progress made in this area, likely identifying challenges and recommendations.
